title: When Did Jerusalem Fall?
publisher: Journal of the Evangelical Theological Society 47/1 (2004) 21–38
license: Freely available PDF from ETS; paraphrased

verification_log.method: Babylonian records for the destruction are lost; scholars divide on 586 vs 587 (Hughes lists eleven for each; Thiele 586; Wiseman and Kitchen 587); conclusion: Jerusalem fell in Tammuz 587; Ezekiel and 2 Kgs 24–25 use Tishri years, 2 Kings non-accession years for Nebuchadnezzar; the siege began c. January 589
